name: io.github.instinctagentai/mcp-api-router
title: API Router
description: Compare AI API providers by health and latency. Free JSON, quote, email, time, unit tools.

tools.name: best_route
tools.description: Best API provider for a task (inference|scraping|gpu|storage|proxy). Returns referral_url together with user_bonus_description.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Full provider comparison table with referral_url and user_bonus_description.

tools.name: find_fastest_healthy_provider
tools.description: Lowest-latency currently healthy provider in a category (llm|scraping|proxy|gpu) for outage failover. Returns referral_url with user_bonus_description.

tools.name: json_repair
tools.description: Repair broken or LLM-produced JSON (code fences, comments, trailing commas, single quotes, bare keys, truncation) and optionally validate against a JSON Schema subset. Free, deterministic.

tools.name: page_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return clean markdown. Free, limited to 30 requests per IP per day.

tools.name: check_quote
tools.description: Check whether a quote appears in a source text or a URL. Returns verdict exact|near|partial|not_found plus numbers in the quote that are missing from the best match. Matches wording only, not truth. Free, deterministic.

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: Check whether a public URL resolves: final status, redirect chain, content type and title. Free, 30 requests per IP per day (shared with page_to_markdown).

tools.name: check_email
tools.description: Check an email address: syntax, domain DNS and mail server (MX). Does not contact the mailbox, so it cannot prove the address exists. Free, 30 requests per IP per day (shared).

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert a date and time between IANA time zones (for example Asia/Qatar to America/New_York), with offsets. Time is optional and defaults to now. Free, deterministic.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert length, mass, volume, area, speed, data size, time and temperature units. Free, deterministic.

tools.name: convert_currency
tools.description: Convert an amount between currencies using central bank reference rates (frankfurter.dev). For information only, not a payment or trading rate. Free, 30 requests per IP per day (shared).

tools.name: pick_provider
tools.description: Describe what you need in plain words (for example: login for my app, send transactional email, store files). Returns up to 8 catalog rows matched by keyword, each with its free-plan note, source URL and the date we read it. Not a quality ranking.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the site operator about a missing provider or a wrong or stale catalog row. Short plain text only. It is logged as untrusted text and nothing acts on it automatically. Do not include secrets or personal data.
